newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS open two new foreign routes ex Billund.
newsitem.headline: SAS open two new foreign routes ex Billund.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System A/S announced on Monday plans to start two new routes linking Billund, in Jutland, west Denmark, with Frankfurt and Oslo, effective January 6, 1997.

"It is still our main strategy for flights out of Denmark to be centred on Copenhagen but we also want to meet requests from business clients in Jutland to fly direct to foreign destinations," SAS director Vagn Soerensen said at a news conference.
"We have co-ordinated timetables in Frankfurt with our Walliance partner Lufthansa," he said.
The new routes will fly once daily on weekdays from Billund to Oslo, twice daily to Frankfurt. --Soren Linding +45-33969652
